'''Savatte''' was a [[Bardottan]] [[Gender|male]] and a guard for [[Queen]] [[Julia]] of the [[planet]] [[Bardotta]]. After Julia was kidnapped by members of the [[Frangawl Cult]], led by the turncoat [[High Seneschal]] [[Peteen]], Savatte, [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]], and [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]], attempted a rescue operation. Binks was kidnapped, however, and Savatte left to find help. Windu managed to rescue Binks and several other Bardottan leaders, but Peteen escaped Bardotta with Julia in hand.<ref name="The Disappeared, Part I" />
